themes.name: Terrace Hour
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace caught at dawn's first warmth — wide eaves, sculptural type, canopy green against terracotta dust, where generous shadows hold the cool interior before the heat arrives.

props.text: Wide eaves. Cool shadow. The moment before the heat arrives — Niemeyer in terracotta and canopy green, held in amber stillness.
DM Sans carries the body — open, direct, unhurried in the cool interior.

themes.name: Wet Folio
themes.description: A late-night reading room where rain-blurred lamplight falls across aged pages — dense scholarly type breathing inside generous margins, stillness made legible.

props.text: Rain against the window. A lamp. Pages that remember every hand that turned them. Stillness made legible.
Dense type breathing inside generous margins, each sentence a room of its own.

themes.name: Shadow Mass
themes.description: Brutalist poster energy rendered in deep umber and raw structural weight — heavy type against intimate dark, a single warm accent cutting through like a found frequency.

props.text: Heavy type. Found frequency. No decoration survives this structure.

themes.name: Fired Earth Aria
themes.description: Hand-cut geometry meets late-afternoon courtyard warmth — mineral pigments, ceramic confidence, pattern as presence.

themes.name: Poolside Firmware
themes.description: A Palm Springs afternoon rendered as system index — aqua precision, navy structure, and the optimistic hum of a CRT in full daylight.

props.text: Palm Springs, 3pm. A CRT hums in full daylight. The pool reflects the interface. Precision is the aesthetic.
Space Grotesk / Manrope — complementary scheme, 2px radius, dots underfoot.

themes.name: Bleached Cadence
themes.description: Overexposed summer stills meet gallery stillness — faded magenta and lawn green breathe inside generous asymmetric space, images leading like a filmstrip left in the sun.

props.text: A filmstrip left in the sun — overexposed edges, gallery hush, magenta burning through the fade.

props.title: Linen Frequency
props.subtitle: October 16, 2026 — Helsinki harbour, fogged and still

props.text: Cold type floats on paper weight. The harbour doesn't announce itself — it simply persists, linen-grey and unhurried, until you notice the tin in the sky.
